analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: We may: collect Usage Data to assist in the operation and improvement of our services; analyse and use Usage Data for marketing or statistical purposes as well as to improve the way we provide services to our users; and serve advertisements or use third-party advertising companies to serve advertisements on our services and on third-party sites, as well as to assist us in analysing our marketing and other business efforts.

analysis.headline: Business Account Admin Accesses Your Data
analysis.quote: For Business Accounts, the administrator of that account can see and deal with the files and data associated with all users within that account (including any Personal Data).

analysis.headline: Law Enforcement Accesses Your Data
analysis.quote: If we think it is necessary or we are obliged by law in any jurisdiction, then we are entitled to give Your Files, Your Chats, any Account Data and any Usage Data to competent authorities, even if those items are encrypted.

analysis.headline: Participates in Lantern Program
analysis.quote: Mega participates in Lantern, the first cross-platform signal sharing programme for companies to strengthen how they enforce their child safety policies.

analysis.headline: Retains Data After Deletion
analysis.quote: Where there is no enforcement action likely or commenced and the 12 month period has expired, or after such longer period as is applicable in the case of records of financial transactions relating to your account that we are legally required to retain, Account Data and Usage Data will be anonymised, and we will never re-identify that data, but where you are a contact of, have had a folder or album shared with you by, or have chatted with, another MEGA user, those details will continue to be retained to allow services to continue for those other users.

analysis.headline: Your Data Transit Globally
analysis.quote: In order to provide our services, Personal Data may transit or be temporarily stored on servers in other countries, the full details of which can be found on our website.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Sites
analysis.quote: Marketing cookies Help us measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and deliver targeted advertisements of our products and services by collecting data about your device and behaviour on our website and tracking you across devices and marketing channels.

analysis.headline: Losing Password Means Data Loss
analysis.quote: If you forget your password you will lose access to all your data unless you have exported and retained a Recovery Key.
